C. Termination allowances due under 8.04A2, 8.04A3 and 8.04A4 shall be at the basic pay rate of the employee at the time of the service termination and shall be in accordance with the following:

D. Termination allowances paid are subject to the following conditions:

1. An employee who has his/her service terminated in accordance with 8.04A and 7.01 after having been re-engaged from a previous service termination under the conditions outlined in 8.04A and 7.01 will be paid the difference between the amount computed as his/her termination allowance and any previous termination payments he/she may have received on account of previous service terminations.
